svg.desc: # Each line has six fields: kind, startx, starty, endx, endy, type
# Comments have their own structure: "#" plus one character plus a space means
# the rest should be read as a text line.
# a line starting with #T specifies the document title.
# a line starting with #R specifies a line in the right block
# a line starting with #K specifies a line in the key
# a line starting with #B is a blank line
# Comments to populate OPD document template
#T Megadungeon of the Mad Archmage Gary-Stu, Level 1: Entry
#R + Discarded, bloody bandages and empty potion flask
#K + *Guard Post*: 2 goblin guards (AC 14 [scale mail]; HP 5,2; Morningstar +2 1d6). Each has 8 sp, 12cp.
#K + *Orc and Pie*: Snouty the orc (AC 16 [chain mail and shield]); HP 8; Falchion +4 (2d4 +4). Tasty pie (cherry).
#K + *Pit Trap*: Covered 30' pit in center of floor, DC 19 to not fall in, DC 5 to detect if anyone looks for it. 3d6 falling damage to room 19 of Level 2, Caves.
#K + *Tripwire and spears*: tripwire 18" off floor, DC 12 to spot if anyone asks. If triggered, 2 spears +6, 1d8 each.
#K + *Barracks*: 11 bunks, 8 goblins. If asleep, will take 2 rounds to wake up, 3 more rounds to get dressed and armored. HP 7, 3, 4, 2, 7, 7, 3, 4.
#K + *Feast Hall*: 6 goblins playing craps. 233 sp, a Lucky Amulet (+1 to hit), and 33cp in the pot. HP 4, 2, 9, 9, 5, 3.
#K + *Goblins' Kitchen*: Kobold _chef de cuisine_ (AC 13; HP 4; Cleaver +0, 1d6-1). 3 halfling line cooks (speak only Spanish) (AC 18; HP 3, 2, 3; Knife +0, 1d4).
#K + *Goblins' Storeroom*: 6 barrels of beer (20gp/200lb), bunch of flour/salt pork/coffee. Well and spiral stairs to wine cellar.
#K + *Throne Room*: Hobgoblin Chieftain Grak (AC 15 [chain mail]; HP 13; Greataxe +5 (1d12+2) and 2 goblin guards (HP 6,2). Grak has 125 gp gem, 38 gp.
#K + *Chief's Quarters*: big waterbed, silk sheets, incense. Total value 150gp, but bulky. 1 female goblin, asleep (HP 2). Tapestry conceals door.
#K + *Harem*: 3 noncombatant female goblins, 1 orc crone (AC 12; HP 6; club +3 1d6+1). 225 gp in assorted jewelry, cosmetics, etc.
#K + *Vizier's Quarters*: Joey Granitethighs, Dwarf (AC 18 [plate]; HP 11; Waraxe +4 (1d8+1)). Gold Chain Of Office worth 55 gp, 22 gp, 18 sp.
#K + *Lieutenant's Quarters*: Urgh the Hobgoblin. (AC 15 [scale mail + shield], HP 13, Longsword +3, 1d8+2). 11 gp.
#K + *Treasure Room*: Golden idol of Grummush worth 270 gp, 113 gp, 19 pp, 344 sp, 12 gems 10-60 gp each. Cask of cognac worth 200 gp (40 lbs).
#K + *Ramp to Surface*: roll logs, barrels, etc. down to storeroom.
#K + *Corwyn's Room*: Corwyn, Fighter 2: (AC 19 [plate + shield]; HP 24; longsword +4 1d8+2). 25 gp, potion of cure light wounds.
#K + *Grand Staircase*: Up to surface, down to level 8.
#K + *Jenna's Room*: Jenna, MU 2. (AC 11; HP 13; dagger +1, 1d4). _Sleep_, _Charm Person_. Spellbook with those spells, 38 gp.
#K + *Dojo*: Master Chu (AC 14; HP 20; 2 fists/feet +2, 1d6+3). No treasure.
#K + *Mess Hall*: 1 monk sweeping (AC 12; HP 14; punch +1, 1d6). No treasure.
#K + *Kitchen*: Kobold _chef de cuisine_, 3 halfling line cooks (see room 7).
#K + *Monks' Cells*: All empty; contain only pallet, bowl, spoon.
#K + *Toilets*: Actual flushing toilets. This is a classy dungeon.
#K + *Entry Hall*: 3 human monks (AC 12; HP 10, 12, 9; punch +1, 1d6). No treasure.
#K + *Monks' Storeroom*: Flour, dried vegetables, potatoes, turnips, etc. Monks are vegetarian.
#K + *Koan Hall*: Master Wu (AC 16; HP 24; 2 fists/feet +2, 1d8+3). No treasure.
#K + *Archery Range*: 2 monks (AC 12; HP 5,5; light crossbow +1, 1d6). No treasure.
